Resolves #21649

Scheduler `eventChange` and Gantt `taskChange` now expose the edit origin as `changeSource` in the event payload, so an app listener can tell a keyboard edit, a drag/resize and an API call apart. `source` stays the sender's component id, exactly as `Neo.core.Observable#fire` injects it — that reserved key is untouched (per the ticket's Out of Scope). The two other object-literal payloads that declared their own `source` (dock `beforeDockZoneDocumentChange`, chip `removevalue`) drop it: no listener in the engine reads it and the injected id already names the sender. The writers' JSDoc and both guides' listener paragraphs name the new key.

Public behavior change: listeners reading the edit origin must use `changeSource`; `source` keeps its documented meaning (sender id) everywhere.

Evidence: L2 (real listener assertions on `eventChange`/`taskChange` plus a source scan of all engine `fire()` payloads) -> L2 required (event metadata + regression coverage; no visual change).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/scheduler/Container.spec.mjs` › "eventChange reports the edit origin as changeSource and keeps source as the sender id (#21649)": ArrowRight move and Shift+ArrowRight resize read `changeSource: 'keyboard'`, a bare `moveEvent(...)` reads `'api'`, a `meta.source: 'drag'` call passes through, and `source` is the scheduler's id each time |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/gantt/Container.spec.mjs` › "taskChange reports the edit origin as changeSource and keeps source as the sender id (#21649)": same assertions for `taskChange` via `moveTask(...)` (`'api'`, `'keyboard'`, `'resize'`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/core/ObservableFirePayloadSource.spec.mjs`: scans every `src/**/*.mjs` for an object-literal `fire('…', {…})` payload declaring `source` and fails on a hit (195 payloads scanned, 0 hits); also pins that `fire()` injects the sender id as `source` |
| AC-4 | `learn/guides/datahandling/Scheduler.md` and `learn/guides/datahandling/Gantt.md` listener paragraphs name `changeSource` and state that `source` is the sender id |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive — the proposed key `changeSource` landed as-is, the input stays `meta.source`, and `Observable#fire` is unchanged.

- Targeted unit suites: `unit/dashboard` + `unit/form/field/Chip.spec.mjs` + `unit/gantt` + `unit/core` → 1587 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing); `unit/scheduler` → 18 passed; `unit/form` + `unit/timeline` → 251 passed. New specs failed before the fix (`changeSource` undefined, scan listed all 4 sites) and pass after.
- Full unit tier `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs` → 8375 passed, 3 skipped, 1 unrelated flake (`unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs:409`, a tooltip timing spec; passes 20/20 standalone, no connection to event payloads)
- Component tier `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs component/form/field/Chip.spec.mjs component/dashboard` → 172 passed (Chromium)
- Repo lint-staged guards on all changed files — `check-whitespace`, `check-shorthand`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-parse`, `check-engine-brain-boundary` (src) and `check-derived-domain`, `check-fixed-sleeps` (test) — all pass
